# Microsoft WebView2 SDK headers 1.0.1150.38

Source package:
https://www.nuget.org/api/v2/package/Microsoft.Web.WebView2/1.0.1150.38

This version is the default pinned by webview 0.12.0. Only the header required
by the amalgamated webview build and Microsoft's license are vendored.

- `include/WebView2.h` SHA-256: `557D5C751148732242B6CED2DBF99D35BED4C4CB471FA50CCF2069A342244CF4`
- `LICENSE.txt` SHA-256: `0AF8F1B807512AAE39C2AC1AA4D0CAE65CABECB6FD554B8439A5162A0D6ECA55`

The WebView2 runtime is not bundled. Windows must provide an installed runtime.
